name: Find Bingles
objectiveText: Find Bingles Blastenheimer in Loch Modan.

comments.body: Found him at 63,48.

Bingles is on the Eastern side of the Loch in Loch Modan. If you're looking at the map, he's just about even with the lettering "Loch".

If you have add-ons like Cosmos, or Titan Panel, his coordinates are 63,47.

I found Bingles at 63,47.

His crashed vehicle is in the water, so as long as you follow the east coast of the lake you will run into him.
I just found Bingles about 25 ft. from his crashed plane.  The plane is located on the east side of The Loch where the water goes the farthest inland...
Go east from Thelsamar and run along the shore of the big lake and you will run into Bingles.  You will see smoke from the crashed gyrocopter.
Confirmed loc 63,48 - he wanders around a tiny bit.

Watch out for the [u]lvl 22 rare crocolisk[/u] on the western banks of the Loch, you don't wanna confront him at lvl 14. He'll tear you to pieces!
Ow, and the croc's got a very original name: Large Loch Crocolisk :-P
